entities.name: Johann Siegmund Valentin Popowitsch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Siegmund Valentin Popowitsch was a philologist and natural scientist from the Archduchy of Austria. His advocacy of a standardized Upper German led to Austrian German as a variety of Standard German.
